verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a REST request-query API (POST /v1/request/query), HQL querying, and a one-line PostHog export, so request data can be pulled out programmatically. A community user says Helicone lets them see each request and 'export them all' to build a fine-tuning dataset. Self-hosting via Docker Compose offers a further route to owning the data and leaving. missing for 10: documented bulk 'export everything' feature, explicit open export formats (CSV/JSON/OTel), coverage of non-request data (prompts, sessions, evaluations) in exports, documented migration/offboarding path.
